episode_summary: In this episode, Vija Williams discusses the changing landscape of real estate, emphasizing the importance of reaching sellers before they contact agents. She highlights the role of cash offer leads and AI in modern real estate strategies, urging agents to become problem solvers with multiple solutions. The episode provides actionable insights for agents and team leaders to adapt and thrive in a post-AI market.
